sources.title: AI‑Powered OBD‑II: How Data‑Driven Diagnostics Are Redefining Vehicle ...
sources.snippet: AI has become the engine behind OBD-II analysis because it can turn raw sensor streams into actionable health insights in real time. Traditional scan tools read static codes, but machine-learning models correlate voltage, temperature, and vibration data to predict failures before they trigger a Diagnostic Trouble Code (DTC).
